Name: Prettier Bathhouse
Author: Louplex
Description:
[center][size=5]❋ Overhaul of Bathhouse interior ❋[/size]
Overhaul of Bathhouse - more compact and with lorefriendly, atmospheric decoration[/center][b][size=2]1.0.6 update: new pool entrance for an even shorter way! :)
[/size]1.0.7 hotfix lights and mapstrings

[/b][size=3]﻿I finally redesigned the Bathhouse… so we can enjoy being there ( ╥ω╥ )[/size]
[size=3]It's smaller and more compact so the Pool is faster accessible. There is only one Locker-Room, it's designed more open to be inclusive. There a still two changing rooms, so it might suit every expectation of a locker. All the funny messages are accessible thou  (¬‿¬ )[/size]

[size=3]﻿Download via Mod Manager or manually.[/size]
[size=3]If manually, drop in 'Mods' Folder using SMAPI.[/size]
[size=3][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url] needed.
It [b]does[/b] work for Android.

The Locker Room is a new custom Map, so other Mods that change this Map are [b]not[/b] compatible unless compatibility is added by it's author. In the Entrance and Pool -Area small overlays like a changed chair, added stairway... can work depending on the position.
Should [b]be[/b] compatible with the popular recoloration Mods, let me know if you notice something unusual. 
This Mod does [b]not[/b] affect Outdoor Maps in any way, there should be no conflict. [/size]

[size=3]Mods i recommend that go well with the aesthetic: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/14524]Elle's Town Buildings[/url].

Want more interior Overhaul? Check out my Mod [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/19423]Prettier Interior[/url]! (Bathhouse already Included)[/size]
